facts.note: Forty-eight blocks east to west is the whole of the map, and no part of it may grow past that.
Forty blocks north to south, which leaves the lip standing clear of the gallery rather than hard against it.
Forty-eight blocks from the rock the cistern is cut into to the sky the silhouette is read against.
The court is sixteen blocks across, so a body standing in the middle of it is out from under every wall.
Eight blocks floor to vault in the gallery, so the ledge can sit above head height and still be looked up at.
The lip stands at least thirty blocks off the mouth, so the walk is walked rather than glanced at.
The ledge floor is at sixty-nine, five above grade, which is the height a body in the gallery has to look up to.
